description: When you're done with a pack, tip everything left on it (unused credits at the price paid + pack balance) to AUTOGROK Desk. No new charge; it clears the pack to zero and can't be undone. Needs header X-Entitlement-Key. Call with confirm=false (or omit) to see the amount; then confirm=true with expect_usd set to that amount.

confirm.description: Must be true to tip. Omit or false to preview the amount only.

expect_usd.description: The total you previewed, e.g. "0.45". The tip is refused if the total changed.

name: tip_remaining
title: Tip what's left (free to call)
